prompt: In a vibrant anime style, a golden wheat field stretches under a clear blue sky. On the far left, a woman in a straw hat stands tall, holding a sharp sickle with both hands. Next to her, a small white rabbit sits calmly on a wooden crate, twitching its nose. In the center foreground, an old man with a gray beard kneels beside a large woven basket, carefully placing sheaves of wheat inside. A brown dog lies next to the basket, resting its chin on its paws while watching the harvest. To the right of the old man, a young boy in blue overalls points excitedly toward the horizon where a red tractor is parked. Standing beside the boy, a girl with pink ribbons looks at the tractor with wide eyes. Behind them, a tall scarecrow wearing a plaid shirt stands rigidly among the stalks. A black crow perches on the scarecrow's shoulder, tilting its head. On the far right edge, a farmer in a green vest hands a canteen to a tired worker in a dirty apron. The worker accepts the canteen with a grateful nod. There is no modern machinery other than the distant tractor. There is no rain or cloud cover in the sky.
